# Foresight Matchmaking

A Foresight Institute directory that pairs listings around open programmes.
Recoding Medicine is the first programme listed. Matching is deterministic:
no LLM on the score. Foresight Institute independently operates this
directory. SPRIND does not operate, control, or assume liability for
matchmaking here.

Operator: Foresight Institute — https://foresight.org
Product: https://foresightmatchmaker.app

## What this is

Listings have a kind: data_holder, ai_team, consortium, or individual.
Individuals are independent experts (not yet on a team). They match with
AI teams and seeking consortia. They do not appear on data-holder shortlists
(holders want a team that can apply). Introductions in the directory are
not gated by match score.

Contact details and dataset governance notes never appear in public payloads.

## Machine-readable contract (start here)

- JSON Schema (profiles): https://foresightmatchmaker.app/api/v1/schema
- JSON Schema (files): https://foresightmatchmaker.app/schema/v1/profile.schema.json
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://foresightmatchmaker.app/openapi.json
- Public aggregates: https://foresightmatchmaker.app/api/v1/stats
- Directory dump (session cookie required): https://foresightmatchmaker.app/api/v1/directory.json
- Human schema pack for Recoding Medicine listings: https://foresightmatchmaker.app/sprind/recoding-medicine-schema.html

## Auth today

Human sign-in is a magic link; subsequent calls use an HTTP session cookie.
There is no API-key or OAuth machine credential yet. Agents and other
directories can read schema + stats without auth. Full listings require a
signed-in member session. Do not scrape HTML; use the JSON routes.

## MCP

Not live. When shipped it will be a thin adapter over this REST surface
(search_directory, get_profile, get_schema, get_matches), not a second
source of truth. Prefer OpenAPI + JSON Schema until then.

## Matching rules (summary)

- Orient organisation pairs as data side + AI side.
- Same kind is a hard block (except consortium ↔ consortium).
- individual ↔ ai_team and individual ↔ seeking consortium: scored (join a team).
- individual ↔ data_holder: not ranked.
- Hard blockers zero the score but are still returned (governance friction
  is the research output).
- Score is 0–100, deterministic, explainable factors.
